observations: Exactly three addresses are published as zero in both competitions although their final on-chain submissions decrypt, validate, and independently compute to nonzero gains and rewards.

All six submissions were included on Polygon on 2023-09-19 between 00:38:45 and 00:42:45 UTC, roughly six days before results publication, so this is not a challenge-close timing pattern like challenge 8.
Every other challenge-19 score and reward reproduces under the 34-symbol scoring basket, including numerous other headerless 34-row submissions.
The same three addresses had exact nonzero reproductions in challenges 9 through 18, so their addresses were not generally excluded.

Address 0x8a8e1c4e454e092fc19c6cca2034bd22b29781e7 updated its UPDOWN submission twice; the verifier uses the final digest retained by the contract. The other five affected address/competition pairs have one submission event.

working_hypotheses.explanation: A production-only inclusion/exclusion rule or database state omitted these three addresses even though their final submissions were present on-chain.
The backend may have processed a different submission digest or failed retrieval/decryption for these addresses; only one affected pair has evidence of an on-chain replacement.

documentation.summary: Challenge 19 has six unresolved raw mismatches: three early, valid on-chain submissions were published as zero in both competitions while all other scores reproduce.
